questions.question: What is the primary chemical substance that makes up the genetic material in living organisms?
Which statement best describes the basic chemical structure of a DNA molecule?
options: A single, straight chain of sugar molecules
Two chains of smaller chemical units joined together
A branching network of proteins and lipids
Three separate rings of carbon atoms connected by bonds

questions.question: What term is used to describe the entire collection of DNA found within a single cell of an organism?
What is the physical shape of a DNA molecule, which consists of two spiralled chains with connecting links?
Why is it possible to see DNA during a fruit extraction experiment even though individual DNA molecules are invisible to the unaided eye?
options: The DNA molecules expand in size when exposed to water
The extraction process dyes the DNA with bright colours
Many DNA molecules clump together into a visible mass
The chemical structure of DNA changes into a solid crystal

questions.question: Inside a cell, the genome is wound up into highly organized, tightly-packed structures called what?
How many pairs of chromosomes are typically found in the nucleus of a normal human body cell?
What name is given to the specific sections of DNA in chromosomes that contain instructions for inherited features and life processes?
What is the role of non-coding DNA sections within an organism's genetic material?
options: They only store instructions for making proteins
They control when the instructions in genes are used
They are waste products that have no function at all
They act as physical barriers to protect the nucleus

questions.question: Where is the genetic material stored in bacterial cells, since they lack a nucleus?
Which term describes the biological process by which organisms pass on physical and physiological features to their offspring?
Except for identical twins, what is typically true about the appearance of offspring from the same parents?
options: They are exact clones of one of the parents
They show variation and are not identical to each other or their parents
They share absolutely no features with either parent
They look identical to their oldest sibling

questions.question: Which of the following statements about characteristics acquired from lifestyle or the environment is correct?
options: They are written into our DNA and passed to offspring
They cannot be inherited by offspring
They always skip one generation before being inherited
They are inherited only if both parents have them

questions.question: Which of the following correctly pairs a genetically inherited feature with an environmentally caused feature?
options: Dyed hair colour (inherited) and natural skin tone (environmental)

questions.question: In 1952, Rosalind Franklin's team in London made a crucial contribution to understanding DNA by using which technique to image the molecule?
